display_long_description:
Grab your controllers and jump straight into Monke’s Territory, a VR gorilla-locomotion playground packed with huge maps, custom game modes, and active multiplayer lobbies.

Maps to Explore
Forest: Scale giant trees and swing through the canopy.
Mountains: High-elevation terrain made for huge leaps.
Pool: The go-to spot to hang out and cool off.
Horror: Dark hallways, eerie vibes, and scary encounters.
Shop: Meet up with others and prepare for the next round.
Game Modes & Mechanics
Glass Bridge: Pick the right tile or take a long fall down.
Monke Up: A vertical parkour test to see who can reach the top first.
Lazer Maze: Work your way through a grid of deadly lasers.
PvP & Zero Gravity: Fight other players or mess around with zero-G physics.
Multiplayer & Voice Chat
Built-in proximity voice chat lets you talk with everyone in your lobby, team up for game modes, or just hang out.

What’s Next
Classic Tag game modes are actively being built and will drop in a future update. The game looks great, though you might spot a few frame drops in certain dense areas while performance optimization is finished up.

Monke's Territory will be updated a LOT over time and will get better and better!
